summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc., a clinical-stage biotech, filed a Form 6-K on August 6, 2026, reporting a press release that its independent Data and Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) unanimously approved advancing its Phase I/II trial of CMND-100 for Alcohol Use Disorder (AUD) from Part A to Parts B and C. Part A showed favorable safety and tolerability. Part B will enroll two cohorts of six patients at 80 mg and 160 mg doses; Part C will test 160 mg daily in healthy participants. This is a routine clinical trial progress update, not a special situation. No deal terms, M&A activity, or strategic corporate event is involved. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report.
